purpose: Astro v7 site migrations, source contract extraction, build parity checks, and a source-cited knowledge vault.

discovery.setup: Python 3.11+ and Node.js 22.12+ (LTS 24.15.0 recommended). Offline doctor, source-audit, ingest preview, verify-build, and docs-lookup require no credentials.
discovery.not_for: Provisioning cloud servers, reverse proxies, or DNS records; executing untrusted astro.config.mjs files during read-only inspection.
examples: Convert my WordPress export or static HTML pages to an Astro v7 site and verify parity
Check why my Astro v7 build broke client scripts, styles, trailing slashes, or content collections
Audit an existing site before migrating to Astro and verify the built dist folder afterward
Attach the Astro v7 knowledge pack to my Empire vault

scope: Portable Python and Node CLI for Astro v7 readiness, HTML/WordPress/Firecrawl migration contract extraction, Content Layer scaffolding, post-build dist/ parity verification, pinned withastro/docs lookup, and attachable Empire knowledge pack.
